mapper.select: SELECT tel_no AS "phone",email_addr AS "email",(use_yn<>'Y' OR (rsgn_dt IS NOT NULL AND rsgn_dt <= #{today})) AS "masked" FROM mst.dev WHERE dev_id=#{id}
SELECT chrg_tel_no AS "phone",txinv_email_addr AS "email",use_yn<>'Y' AS "masked" FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=#{id}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_role ur JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id JOIN sys.role_menu_auth a ON a.role_id=r.role_id JOIN sys.menu m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.use_yn='Y' AND a.contact_inq_auth_yn='Y' AND a.inq_auth_yn='Y' AND m.scrn_id=#{screenId} AND m.use_yn='Y' AND r.role_id IN #{grant.roleId} AND (
#{purpose}='STAFF_OPERATION' AND r.role_id IN (4,5) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id} AND ( (r.data_scope_cd='PART' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys.user_part up JOIN mst.bsn_part bp ON bp.bsn_part_id=up.bsn_part_id WHERE up.user_id=#{userId} AND up.bsn_part_id=d.bsn_part_id AND bp.use_yn='Y')) OR (r.data_scope_cd='PROJECT' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn ag JOIN sys.user_prj up ON up.prj_id=ag.prj_id JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=up.prj_id WHERE ag.dev_id=d.dev_id AND up.user_id=#{userId} AND p.use_yn='Y' AND ag.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND ag.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND ag.end_dt >= #{today})) ))
(#{purpose}='BILLING_RECEIPT_PAYMENT' AND r.role_id=3 AND r.data_scope_cd='ALL' AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id WHERE p.cust_ptnr_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.pay pay WHERE pay.ptnr_id=#{id}))) OR (#{purpose}='CONTRACT_SALES' AND r.role_id=4 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM prj.prj p JOIN sys.user_part up ON up.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id JOIN mst.bsn_part bp ON bp.bsn_part_id=up.bsn_part_id WHERE up.user_id=#{userId} AND p.use_yn='Y' AND bp.use_yn='Y' AND r.data_scope_cd='PART' AND ( p.cust_ptnr_id=#{id} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn ag JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=ag.dev_id WHERE ag.prj_id=p.prj_id AND d.vndr_ptnr_id=#{id} AND ag.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND ag.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND ag.end_dt >= #{today}))))
))
